questions.title: Bubble Sort Algorithm
questions.statement:
Implement the Bubble Sort algorithm to sort an array in ascending order.

**Examples:**
- Input: [64, 34, 25, 12, 22, 11, 90] → Output: [11, 12, 22, 25, 34, 64, 90]
- Input: [5, 2, 8, 1, 9] → Output: [1, 2, 5, 8, 9]
questions.inputFormat: First line contains N (size of array), second line contains N space-separated integers.
questions.outputFormat: Return the sorted array as space-separated integers.
